authored_projection_controls.identity: Exact distinct recorded email strings, including case and surrounding whitespace, stay distinct. Literal multiline/HTML-looking names and leading-zero invoice numbers remain exact; multiple names for one exact email stay associated.
authored_projection_controls.dates: Use supplied canonical snapshot day; leap-day difference, due-today, later and null/undated classification. No wall-clock or local-zone inference.
authored_projection_controls.immutability: Projection and filtering leave input values unchanged. A previously prepared projection retains copied row primitives after source-object mutation.
authored_projection_controls.empty: A valid empty native snapshot yields zero counts and no invented client/currency/row.
